row.scim_plan: Any package on Adobe Identity (Contact Sales)
row.evidence: Marketo Engage's four packages all say "Get pricing"; new subscriptions use the Adobe Admin Console for user management, whose Microsoft Entra ID Sync "uses the SCIM protocol" for "Adobe products that belong to ... Experience Cloud".
row.notes: Quote-only: Growth, Select, Prime and Ultimate are all 'Get pricing' (Growth 10 users, the others 25). Subscriptions from July 31, 2023 are on Adobe Identity, so users and SSO live in the Adobe Admin Console and provisioning is Adobe's Entra ID Sync or Google Sync (SCIM) on a federated directory. Deprovisioning disables the user and keeps the account. New users land as Standard User in the Default workspace; Marketo roles are set in Marketo or through Marketo's User Management API. Okta's Marketo app and the Entra and JumpCloud Marketo apps are SSO only; Entra provisioning uses Microsoft's Adobe Identity Management (SAML) app. Which packages include SSO is not published, so sso_plan is null. Older non-Adobe-Identity subscriptions are not covered by these pages.

auth.token_source: Adobe Admin Console sync setup issues a Tenant URL and Secret token for the Entra gallery app

operations.notes: Deprovisioning disables the user in the Admin Console; the account is not removed.

deprovision.data_retained: User is disabled in the Adobe Admin Console; the account and cloud-stored assets are not removed from the organization.

roles.how: Admin Console assigns a Marketo Engage product profile; the user lands as 'Standard User' in the Default workspace and Marketo roles are changed inside Marketo Engage (or via the Marketo User Management API).

limitations.text: Only Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace sync are documented; other IdPs must use the User Sync Tool, the User Management API or CSV.
Requires a federated directory with a verified domain; once Entra sync is on, users cannot be managed manually or with other sync methods.
Applies only to subscriptions on Adobe Identity (all new subscriptions from July 31, 2023); older native-Marketo subscriptions are not covered by these pages.
New users get the Standard User role in the Default workspace; Marketo roles and workspaces cannot be set through the sync.

scim.notes: Marketo Engage subscriptions created on or after July 31, 2023 use the Adobe Admin Console for users and SSO. SCIM is Adobe's Admin Console 'Sync' for Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace on a federated (SSO) directory, which Adobe says covers Experience Cloud products. The SCIM version and a generic endpoint for other clients are not documented.

user_api.notes: Marketo's own User Management endpoints (no /rest prefix). On Adobe IMS-integrated subscriptions, invite, update and delete apply to API-only users; standard users are managed through the Adobe User Management API (Enterprise).

endpoints.purpose: Get a user's roles and workspaces
Invite user (API-only users on IMS subscriptions)

rate_limits.text: Daily API call quota per package: 20k calls/day on Growth, 50k on Select, Prime and Ultimate.

limitations.text: On Adobe IMS-integrated subscriptions the Marketo endpoints invite, update and delete API-only users only; standard users go through the Adobe User Management API.
Delete is destructive and cannot be reversed; there is no documented deactivate.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML and SWA as checked; no provisioning capabilities.

entra.notes: Microsoft's Marketo gallery app is IdP-initiated SSO only; provisioning goes through the Adobe Identity Management (SAML) app tied to the Adobe Admin Console.

google.notes: Adobe Google Sync, configured through Google's Adobe SAML app auto-provisioning (Adobe Admin Console, not Marketo-specific).

fallbacks.other_sync: Adobe User Sync Tool (Active Directory/LDAP) and Adobe User Management API
fallbacks.notes: Adobe automatic account creation lets federated users create their own accounts through SSO (Enterprise customers with a federated directory).
